short: Gets administrator rights so it can do more.
analogy: Finds the key to the director’s office and the safe.

solutionNotes.edr: Spots UAC bypass, token theft and injection into processes.
solutionNotes.siem: Alerts when someone joins privileged groups or changes policies.
solutionNotes.pam: Administrator rights are granted only for the length of a task — there’s almost nothing to steal.
solutionNotes.vm: Closes vulnerabilities that let an ordinary user become an administrator.
solutionNotes.ueba: Spots accounts that suddenly act like administrators.
solutionNotes.cnapp: Looks for excessive permissions and unsafe container settings.
